description: task-planner skill thresholds — all mutable numbers live here

max_vc.description: Minimum Verification Contract items per plan (Std 44)

min_verification_per_phase.description: Minimum V-N checks bound to each phase (Std 45)

retry_count.description: Max retries on same V-N FAIL before escalating to user (Std 42)

max_tool_calls_before_refresh.description: Tool calls threshold before re-reading task_plan.md (Std 10)

template_priority.description: Template search order: project-level first, then built-in fallback

todo_sync_interval_calls.description: Tool calls threshold before PostToolUse hook emits a native-Todo sync reminder (see references/todo-sync.md)

plan_update_interval_minutes.description: Max allowed age of task_plan.md before PostToolUse hook forces a plan-doc write-back reminder; also check-doc-sync.sh default

stale_remind_cooldown_calls.description: After a stale-plan reminder, suppress further stale reminders for this many tool calls (anti-nag cooldown)

prompt_note_interval.description: UserPromptSubmit [plan-note] throttle: inject on 1st prompt of a session, then every Nth prompt
